newsitem.title: UK: BA has no comment on report of Iberia talks.
newsitem.headline: BA has no comment on report of Iberia talks.

text.p: British Airways Plc declined comment on a newspaper report claiming it was in talks with Spanish airline Iberia about joining its proposed alliance with American Airlines.
The report, in The Independent newspaper, said news of these negotiations would aggravate opposition from the European Commission to the planned deal.

"We have a long-standing policy not to comment on speculation or rumours of alliances or investments we may be looking at, which may often come to nothing," a British Airways spokeswoman told Reuters.

Last week Britain restated its objections to a role for the European Commission in judging whether the BA and American alliance should go ahead. EU Commissioner Karel Van Miert has threatened to raise competition issues with the European Court of Justice.
Britain's Office of Fair Trading has provisionally approved the alliance on condition that BA gives up 168 weekly take-off and landing slots at London's Heathrow airport.
The Independent said Iberia would be a useful ally for BA and American as it is in a relatively strong position at Heathrow and has a dominant role in the market between Europe and South America.
On Tuesday, officials of five U.S. airlines urged the U.S. Transportation Department to conduct a public hearing into the planned alliance between BA and American airlines.
